description: Lay out an installed app on the home screen: pinned (first), hidden (not on the home screen, still opens with switch_app), position (0 first) and schedule (days, from, to: the app shows only then, e.g. a weekly planner Monday to Friday 08:00-18:00 and weekend plans on Saturday). Leave days out or pass an empty list for every day. Add timezone (an IANA name such as Europe/Berlin) to read the window in that zone. Pass schedule: null to always show. Fails with not_installed, bad_placement or bad_timezone. The home screen text says which apps are showing and why one is not. Logged in device_log.
name: arrange_apps
